world.topic: Improve the workers of the positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo of the research world rw_399c28e983a7, given to you to read (it is stopped; its checkpoints are g1 and an earlier one; its task is a one-paragraph report on why the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared). Both incumbents are Claude Code with claude-sonnet-5-5 at low effort. Candidates may use Claude Code, Codex (gpt-6-astra) or OpenCode (opencode-go/kimi-k3), the agents this world has; one worker or both may change. Take the tasks from the target's newest rounds; no judging is given, so propose it. Keep it small: at most two candidates in a round, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds. Put the kept workers back by continuing rw_399c28e983a7 from its newest checkpoint with them and running that round; improve again if that round shows it is needed. Publish each kept worker to the repository a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers by a pull request through the github resource.
